Guidance For Every Stage

Buying a home can be a learning process full of new terminology. Even after closing on your dream home, you probably still have questions about maintaining your mortgage, understanding your responsibilities as a homeowner, and planning for the future. The Consumer Financial Protection Bureau has information that can help.

Visit consumerfinance.gov

Idaho Housing Home Loan Help

View your account details, check your loan balance, and make payments through the HomeLoanServ Borrower Connection portal.

Access HomeLoanServ

Frequently Asked Questions

Where can I learn about mortgage basics?

Visit consumerfinance.gov for mortgage basics, how-to guides, and more.

What can I do if I’m having trouble making my monthly mortgage payment?

If you are facing challenges that make paying your mortgage difficult, the best thing to do is make a plan and take action.

  • Seek expert advice through free Housing Counseling with a HUD approved counselor.
  • Review information from the Consumer Financial Protection Bureau to understand mortgage forbearance and avoid foreclosure.
Where can I access my Idaho Housing loan information?

If you have a home loan through Idaho Housing, you can view your account details, check your loan balance, and make your mortgage payments online anytime through HomeLoanServ.

Sign in to your HomeLoanServ account.
